expires_at.description: When the link stops working: 5 minutes after it was made.

file_name.description: As the uploader named it: data, never a path (FR-DOC-08).

media_type.description: Its type, decided from its content when it was attached.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the file as stored, in hexadecimal, to check what was saved.

url.description: Open it within expires_at: the file is served as an attachment named file_name, of type media_type. A path starting /api/ is on the web app's own origin.
